title: Hines playing unaccompanied; Terrace intermissions
summary: Hines sometimes played alone, on a small white piano.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: Did Earl play unaccompanied sometimes? You know, without the band, or without the rhythm section?
Yes, sometimes he'd play without the rhythm section.
Did he play on the stand, or was there another piano?
No, it was on the stand. Well, now, if he did a number in the show that they had a little special white piano, and they used to put it out on the floor.
What happened on intermissions? Did you have an intermission piano player, or --
